principles.display: Closed changed-only kind/field vocabulary with known_value, known_none, and unknown. No raw variables or current-profile reconstruction.
principles.general: A new sale with customer_id null and no customer_name is known_none General. A null id with a nonblank written name is a name-only known_value identity. A persisted is_anonymous=1 customer is also General while its stored id remains available for guarded repair/replay. Missing legacy evidence is unknown.
principles.retention: sale_record_events and return_mutation_receipts are immutable, included in backup/reset lifecycle, and excluded from ordinary audit/action-history pruning.
principles.legacy: Genuine historical sale-related rows without exact typed evidence remain one legacy_sale_change record with actor/time and details unavailable. They are not silently dropped.
principles.contact_privacy: Phone/address carry is a visible customer_contact_changed fact with changed_contact_fields metadata only. No old or new contact values and no fabricated booleans are retained.

not_yet_captured.reason: The first event implementation was reverted after a proven concurrent same-sale creation race. The safe replacement requires one atomic header/items/allocations/stock/status/event batch with stable item ids; no provisional row is allowed.
not_yet_captured.preserved_behavior: Existing return and audit history remains visible as legacy_sale_change rather than disappearing.

not_yet_captured.action: customer profile carry rename/phone/address and merge/relink/resolve-missing
not_yet_captured.reason: contacts.ts can rewrite sales customer snapshots or ids without per-sale immutable F74 events. Record-only profile edits intentionally do not mutate a sale and need no Sales Record. The exact source/receipt/atomic set-write contract is frozen but not implemented.
not_yet_captured.privacy: The frozen extension retains only customer id/name and membership identity plus changed_contact_fields=phone/address. It never copies either contact value into the immutable ledger.

not_yet_captured.reason: settings.ts rewrites historical sale payment labels in one guarded operation but does not yet append per-sale immutable F74 events. A constant-statement SQL set-insert and stable receipt are planned but not implemented.

release_dependencies: Direct status and return edit server requirements must ship with a frontend that freezes client_request_id and expected_updated_at before send and preserves exact requests across unknown outcomes.
The current frontend candidate e04e0b15 has a separate blocked review for pending-request retention bounds and Undo/Redo reconciliation; backend commits alone are not a release candidate.

Direct PATCH /api/sales/:id/customer now requires a stable client_request_id and expected_updated_at. The mounted F72 customer editor uses the bulk-update kernel; any future direct caller must implement the same unknown-outcome retry discipline.
Anonymous handling depends on append-only migration 0141 and its shared helper; F74 must not deploy without that schema dependency and the paired UI interpretation of customer_is_anonymous.
The marker backend authority repair 3406d17c is integrated as ef640cb9; paired frontend masking 7ba9aa72 remains required in the release candidate.

The contract-only customer_contact_changed kind is not implemented in the current event schema/reader and must not be advertised as captured until its migration, backend writers, EN/KM UI, lifecycle tests, and independent review land together.
No migration, deployment, remote D1 command, or production write was performed.
